+2. After inserting, confirm the intro's lines match the archive's creation commit (`9a862b8`). Verify losslessness the way Session 142 did: byte-containment checks against `git show HEAD:<path>`, not `git diff` (the archive crossed `core.bigfilethreshold` in Session 142 and is a binary diff from here on — content is unaffected, only `git diff`'s line view).
